definition: Repayment of eligible work-related expenses rather than ordinary wages.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 7 distinct documented reimbursement implementation events across 6 municipalities in 4 states. Repayment of eligible work-related expenses rather than ordinary wages. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
